_help: One brand's data: everything a renderer or a script reads. Copy with `python3 scripts/brand.py new <slug>`, fill it, run `brand.py check <slug>` until it reports 0 problems, then `brand.py use <slug>`. Keys starting with _ are notes and are never read. Any path starting with assets/ is relative to this brand's folder; `use` copies assets/ to motion-graphics/public/brand-active/ and rewrites the path, so a config refers to the same file as brand-active/<rest>. Leave a field "" to hide what it draws. A field you do not know yet: write UNKNOWN and check lists it. The human side (who, voice, do and never, sources) is BRAND-GUIDE.md; keep the two in step.

brand._help: Identity. slug = the folder name. name = exactly as written on screen. written = how the name must and must never be written. what = the free and paid products in one sentence. audience = who buys, with shares if known. file_prefix = the first token of every delivered filename (short, capitals, e.g. ACME). output_root = where finished ads land; "" means motion-graphics/out/<slug>/, an absolute path keeps the work outside the engine.

claims._help: Every number or fact an ad may state, each with its source and date, e.g. "subscribers": "12,000. Source: the mailing tool dashboard, 2026-01-05". A claim with no source does not go in an ad.

_never_help: Hard rules, one sentence each: banned words, claims never made, people never shown, anything legal ruled out. Check every script against these before rendering.

people._help: One key per person who may appear or be named: real footage allowed, cloning allowed (and whose written consent), how they are named on screen. Empty if no people appear.

offer._help: The offer in its exact words. free = the free step (routes_to: where the click goes, cta: the button, close: the closing line, whose sentences after the brand name also become the end-card sublines). paid = the paid step (cta, outro = the spoken paid close, price as it may be said). A brand with only one step fills free and leaves paid blank. one_place = a reminder that the offer is edited here, never in one ad.
offer.one_place: The offer lives in exactly one place. To change it, change it here and re-render.

offer_numbers._help: The numbers the paid formats print (AerialKinetic, OfferCard, the Cards ledger). readers and members are display strings ("12,000", "600+"); total (the dollar value of included deals), tools (how many deals) and price (a year) are numbers; currency is the symbol printed before money. Verify each at source before a render that will run. A config can override any of them.

what_works._help: Optional notes for script writers: hook style, script shape, headline style, what was tested and lost.

judged_on._help: Optional: the one metric an ad is judged on, and why.

delivery._help: Optional notes: ratios, lengths, music, what ships per ad.

palettes._help: Two palettes. dark: light text on a dark ground (OneWord, dark Cards). paper: dark text on a light ground (paper Cards). bg and ink need at least 7:1 contrast (check warns under it). accent has ONE job, marking what the eye lands on; it must pop on both bg and ink. muted = secondary lines, dim = inactive text. captionBg = the Cards caption band (default bg). wordmark = the platform or product wordmark on the end card for this ground ("" hides it). scrimTo = CSS gradient that fades artwork into the caption band. readOnLarge = colour of the small label above the wordmark on the large Cards end card (default muted).

fonts._help: CSS font stacks for OneWord and Cards (serif = headlines and captions, sans = labels, sansCards = Cards labels, default sans). files = font files to load first, each {family, file, weight}; put the file in assets/fonts/ and use its family name at the front of a stack. Only fonts whose licence allows use in ads (SIL OFL is safe). System stacks need no file.

end_card._help: The end card of OneWord and Cards, and the person byline. avatar = round photo or mark ("" hides it). platformLabel = small label above the palette wordmark, e.g. "Read it on" ("" hides both). freeSubline / paidSubline = lines under the name ("" derives them from offer.free.close). cta = the button ("" uses offer.free.cta). paidFollowOn + paidFollowOnAccent = the second line on PAID cuts, the accent part in the accent colour. offerEyebrow = the label that appears on PAID OneWord cuts where the offer starts.

voice._help: Defaults for scripts/voice.py; `brand.py show` prints the full command. engine = gemini | minimax | elevenlabs | seed | seedance (or "" when a real person records). voice = the engine's voice name or id. style = the style prompt (gemini, seedance). speed = playback speed (1.0 = as generated). say_as = {"Spelling": "SaidAs"} applied to the TTS text only; `use` writes it to .say_as.active.json for --say-as.

rsvp._help: OneWord (RSVP) tuning; delete any key to use the engine default shown. anchor = where the fixed letter sits, as a share of frame width (move LEFT for long words, never centre the word). sizes = [maxChars, px] buckets, first match wins, null = every longer word. shortWordMax / accentRun = words this short get no accent run, others get accentRun extra accent letters. bg = the ground behind the words. freeEndCard / paidEndCard = end-card seconds. bedUnderVoice / bedUnderCard = music level under the read and under the card.

_featured_help: The deals or partners allowed on screen as logo tiles (AerialKinetic deals wall, OfferCard rows), in wall order: [{"name": "Partner", "src": "assets/logos/partner.png"}]. Only deals a customer can actually redeem.

ledger._help: The Cards format's PAID outro: free column on the left, paid column on the right. freeLabel / freeRows = the free column. paidLabel = the paid column's label. price = the price line, lit on the first spoken word in priceCues. worth = the line after it, lit on worthCue. tools = logo chips: [{name, file: "assets/logos/x.svg", kind: "lockup" | "icon"}] (icon = the name is set beside the mark). more = text after the chips ("" hides it). extras = [[label, the spoken word that cues it in]].

aerial._help: AerialKinetic. font = the one typeface {family, file, weight}. markColor = ring round the person byline. accent / accentWord / accentInk = pills and buttons / lit spoken words / text on the accent. mark = round brand mark (logo byline). personName = the person's name beside end_card.avatar (person byline). cobrandBy = the line under the name when the mark leads and the person rides on it. platformWordmark / platformMark = the free product's wordmark and square mark. communityLogo = the paid product's square mark. hookLabel = the word on the person who lights up in the default hook graphic. wallThumbs = video thumbnails for the 'wall of videos' (may be empty: grey tiles). copy = every string the format prints; {price} {cents} {total} {tools} {readers} {members} {unit} {units} are filled per ad; rows = [[label, sub-line, spoken cue word]]. beats = which graphic a sentence gets, first match wins: {beat: hook|bridge|identity|platform|community|deals|close, any: [words], starts: [opening words]}; {price} and {total} expand to $180, $1250. cues = single spoken words that time a piece of a graphic. keys = words lit in accentWord as they are said.

offer_card._help: OfferCard. font = {family, file, weight}. accent = checks, eyebrow, highlighted row edge, button glow. captionAccent = the word being said in the caption band. rowHighlight = background of the row being said. shine = the headline shine colour on a dark and a light card. mark = round brand mark (logo byline). personName = name beside end_card.avatar (person byline). communityLogo / cardTitle = the card's header. bylinePerson / bylineLogo = the line under the byline name ({readers}). button / perDay = button text and the line under it ({price} {cents}). captionFixes = [[regex, flags, replacement]] for words Whisper mishears.

aerial_static._help: motion-graphics/scripts/render_aerial.py: a static text block plus a lockup burned onto a clip. lockup_mark = square mark beside the wordmark. wordmark = the name as set in the lockup. wordmark_font / wordmark_variation = its font file and named variation ("" for a static font). tag_free / tag_paid = the line under the lockup. copy = {persona_key: [paragraph, ...]}. hooks = {persona_key: a replacement first paragraph} (builds <key>_v2). paid = {prefix: text put before paragraph 2, offer: the offer paragraph, close: the last line} (builds <key>_paid and <key>_paid_v2).

presenter._help: Styling for the toolbox tools (compose_shots, type_overlay, doc_sweep, record_interaction, quote_card, redact). fonts = TTF/OTF files for heavy (pills), bold (captions), regular, light (number screens). colors = hex. presenter = the cutout's corner (left|right), width and bottom edge as shares of the frame per ratio, and px faded at its sides/bottom. safe_zone = where text may sit, shares of the frame per ratio. caption = size (share of width), stroke px, chunking (max_words, max_chars, hard_max_words, lines), replace = {"spoken form": "written form"} for captions only, weak_words a chunk never ends on. label/hook/name_card/number = sizes as shares of width. grade = still and clip look (contrast, saturation, lift 0-255, warm, grain sigma). audio = speed, voice_eq (ffmpeg filter), bed (path), bed_db, bed_end_lift (gain on the bed under the close), lufs, true_peak, sfx (false: no sound effects). export = x264 crf and rate cap.
